== NAME

table-presentation - verify table presentation

== SYNOPSIS

table-presentation

== DESCRIPTION

.Ends frame, row grid, proportional columns, header, and footer
[frame=ends,grid=rows,cols="1,3",options="header,footer"]
|===
| Name | Description

| one
| first

| two
| second

| Total | two rows
|===

.Sides frame, column grid, percentage widths, and centered table
[frame=sides,grid=cols,cols="25%,75%",width=60%,align=center]
|===
| one | first
| two | second
|===

.Content-determined columns without rules
[frame=none,grid=none,cols="~,~",options=autowidth]
|===
| short | a longer value
| tail | end
|===
